discovery_budget.discovery: Exported weight tensors are bound into runtime buffers with a packing stride that disagrees with the export contract, so short prompts can still match goldens while longer prompts accumulate layout-sensitive decode divergence.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming export packing stride or weight-layout binding would collapse the C++ diagnosis into a disclosed tensor-layout recipe.

discovery_budget.discovery: Incremental generation working-set slots are written/read with a wrong index stride, so longer sequences reuse or skip slots while cache-hit counters can still look plausible.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming KV-cache slot stride or write/read indexing would directly expose the Rust repair and convert the task into a recipe.

discovery_budget.discovery: Serve-time sequence-index offsets applied during generation diverge past a length threshold, so long-prompt greedy tokens disagree even when upstream buffers look locally consistent.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming positional/RoPE phase or sequence-index offset policy would reduce the third repair to a disclosed encoding flip.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: The public draft describes short-prompt-green / long-prompt-wrong greedy decode, healthy cache-hit/latency summaries, short controls that must remain unchanged, and a cited report schema without naming algorithms, thresholds, KV strides, RoPE phases, packing bugs, or causes.

causal_chain.unlocks_next: The conditional matrix justifies treating short-green / long-wrong as one serve incident rather than a general model failure.

causal_chain.evidence: Inspect run logs, metrics counters, and ember_report.json fields for short versus long trajectories.
causal_chain.finding: Disagreement concentrates on long-prompt sequence fields after generation extends past short lengths, not on export-check banners or short controls.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: Investigation can focus on state that crosses the short-to-long generation boundary across C++ and Rust roots.

causal_chain.evidence: Trace exported weight binding and native buffer packing against short/long decode baselines.
causal_chain.finding: Export binding stride disagrees with the runtime contract in a way short prompts can still tolerate.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: Weight-binding repair becomes a necessary but not sufficient stage before slot indexing and sequence offsets are trusted.

causal_chain.evidence: Compare incremental working-set write/read indices across length thresholds using deterministic probes.
causal_chain.finding: Slot indexing uses a wrong stride, explaining long-sequence divergence while cache-hit counters remain plausible.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: Slot indexing must be repaired in concert with weight binding; sequence offsets still remain unchecked.

causal_chain.evidence: Inspect serve-time sequence-index offset intermediates on long trajectories.
causal_chain.finding: Offsets diverge past a length threshold, so greedy tokens disagree even when upstream buffers look locally repaired.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: The three authorities can now be repaired as one coupled invariant and verified end-to-end.

causal_chain.evidence: Apply coordinated repairs at reed, silt, and weld locations; rebuild; rerun short/long matrices.
causal_chain.finding: Long prompts recover golden sequences; short controls remain unchanged; cache-hit/latency alone is not treated as success.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: This closes the incident with deterministic outcome evidence.

investigation_profile.determinism_strategy: Ship fixed C++/Rust sources, export fixtures, prompt families, and logs in one offline container. Reset from immutable inputs before each scenario, avoid clocks and runtime entropy, pin reduction and slot traversal order, and derive expected short/long properties from verifier-owned regeneration.

topology_enumeration.summary: Exported-weight binding stride, incremental working-set slot indexing, and serve-time sequence-index offsets disagree across reed, silt, and weld.
topology_enumeration.why_no_single_location_suffices: Correct weight binding can still be undone by wrong slot strides, correct slots can still miss long goldens under wrong sequence offsets, and offset-only repairs leave long sequences red when binding disagrees.

topology_enumeration.summary: Export bind, working-set write, working-set read, and sequence-offset apply form a four-stage serve lifecycle chain.
topology_enumeration.why_no_single_location_suffices: Correct export bind is useless if writes land in the wrong slots, correct writes are useless if reads use a different stride, and correct buffers are useless if sequence offsets diverge past a length threshold.

topology_enumeration.summary: C++ packing convention, Rust slot keys, and Rust sequence-index offsets use incompatible conventions after short-to-long generation.
topology_enumeration.why_no_single_location_suffices: Changing one convention only moves the disagreement to another boundary; producers and consumers must represent the same long-prompt decode map.
